ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_COPY.title: Copy
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_MIRROR_IMAGE.title: Mirror Image
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_MIRROR_IMAGE.descrip:
At the start of your turn, each mirror [gold]Executes[/gold] 1.
Cards you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] copies of the first card you play each turn are stored in mirrors.
Whenever you take unblocked damage, one of your mirrors dies.
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_EXECUTE.title: Execute
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_EXECUTE.description: If the stored card does not have [gold]Exhaust[/gold] and is not a Power, play it at a random enemy. Otherwise, play it at a random enemy and put it into the exhaust pile.
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_FIRST_MOVE.title: First Move
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_FIRST_MOVE.descripti: Triggers only if this is the first card you play this turn.
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_TRANSMUTE.title: Transmute
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_TRANSMUTE.descriptio: [gold]Transform[/gold] a card. At the start of your next turn, [gold]transform[/gold] it into what it was before that [gold]transform[/gold].
